caveats: Baseline pools are built from the 1992-2002 baseline years plus the +-5-calendar-day extension days specified by the method (1991-12-27 to 1991-12-31 and 2003-01-01 to 2003-01-05), so the first/last days actually used are 1991-12-27 and 2003-01-05; all 4118 days in that span were present in the dataset. Day of year 60 (29 Feb) has no pool of its own and was set to the mean of days 59 and 61 before smoothing; smoothing is an unweighted 31-day centred moving mean wrapping modulo 366. Sea cells are the 3286 region cells with finite SST on every target day; the other 314 cells (land/ice) are 0 in the mask and excluded. Regional events run from the first to the last day on which at least one sea cell is inside a per-cell MHW: 2019-06-05 to 2019-06-22 (18 d), 2019-07-19 to 2019-07-29 (11 d), 2019-08-26 to 2019-08-31 (6 d, cut off by the end of the target period). All computations were done in float64.
